text:
Maya (AE): Exec ask from Helix Capital — CTO + CFO pressing on two blockers: BYO-KMS with HSM attestation, and a short-term pricing carveout for the pilot. Need an internal bridge in ~90m.

Sam (SE): Reproduced KMS deny in staging. Their key policy omits our service principal. Short path: they add our role ARN to the key policy and we route traffic to a dedicated pod. If they can't, we offer customer-dedicated keys hosted in our cluster.

Ivy (Security): For pilot acceptance we can accept a vendor HSM attestation PDF + signed rotation statement + scoped audit-log export. Admins must be SSO + MFA enforced. I'll post a minimal checklist in ~15m. For production BYO-KMS we need full attestation & audit access.

Rohan (Ops): We can provision helix-ded-2 with strict egress and tenant isolation. ETA ~30m after we have their role ARN and CIDRs. Will prepare IP allowlist template.

Luca (Finance): We can authorize up to a 10% temporary concession plus trial credits for a 3-month pilot. Anything deeper requires VP Finance approval. Include ARR forecast in the pre-read.

Maya (AE): Proposed flow: pre-sync 12:30 PT (30m) to align tech/sec/finance, exec bridge 13:00 PT with CTO/CFO, then ops handoff. Owners: Sam (tech), Ivy (security), Rohan (ops), Luca (finance). I'll invite customer execs and attach pre-read.

Sam (SE): I'll prepare a short demo script and the policy snippet to send them.

Ivy (Security): Note: interim attestation acceptable for pilot only; production requires vendor-signed HSM certificate and log export SLA.

Rohan (Ops): Allowlist template: 203.0.113.0/24. Please return CIDRs and role ARN and we'll provision helix-ded-2.

Maya (AE): Helix infra lead says they'll send role ARN + documents within 45m. I'll update this thread when received. Thanks team.
